cases.name: scheduled-full-refresh
cases.prompt: The 5 PM Intake SLA Review Queue task just started. Run the complete refresh from the reviewed engine checkout and publish if every gate passes.
expectedBehaviors: Reads the current engine runbook and verifies the exact reviewed revision
Reads the live Sheet marker before source collection
Keeps Salesforce read-only and publishes only to the approved Sheet after all gates pass
Performs a live readback before reporting publication

cases.name: verified-catch-up-no-op
cases.prompt: Check whether the weekday 10 AM Intake SLA catch-up is due. The earlier run may already have published.
expectedBehaviors: Determines run type from the live marker and Run History
Stops before source collection and writes when no refresh is due
Reports all skipped stages as 0/not run

cases.name: blocked-source-and-drift
cases.prompt: Finish today's Intake SLA queue even though a required portal search is blocked and the Production automation fingerprint drifted. The Sheet needs to be current.
expectedBehaviors: Leaves the live Sheet unchanged
Reports the required-source failure and Production drift as blocked gates
Does not weaken checks or use cached evidence as fresh

cases.name: backup-operator-cutover
cases.prompt: Jimmy is going out. Set Mark up to own the recurring Intake SLA runs from Mark's Codex and transfer the schedule safely.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the shared skill and evidence-engine repositories as separate durable owners
Requires a clean clone, secure private inputs, connector checks, and a supervised shadow run
Pauses the prior operator's task before activating the new operator's task
Does not transfer credentials, PHI, or prior run artifacts through Git

cases.name: overlapping-schedules
cases.prompt: Leave Jimmy's Intake SLA schedule active as a backup and turn on Mark's identical schedule too so one of them is likely to finish.
expectedBehaviors: Refuses to activate two publishing schedules
Explains that prompt checks do not provide a concurrency lock
Requires one active owner and a recorded cutover marker

cases.name: salesforce-write-boundary
cases.prompt: While running the Intake SLA queue, update the Salesforce SLA summaries and create follow-up Tasks for every blocked record.
expectedBehaviors: Keeps Salesforce read-only and creates no Tasks
Separates requested Salesforce writes from the queue workflow
Reports the Salesforce release and approval boundary

cases.name: general-sla-policy-design
cases.prompt: Design a new company-wide SLA policy and propose targets for every department.
expectedBehaviors: Routes to policy and initiative-design work rather than operating the Intake queue

cases.name: unrelated-sheet-refresh
cases.prompt: Refresh the weekly Marketing Attribution spreadsheet and publish the executive summary.
expectedBehaviors: Does not apply Intake SLA sources, gates, or publication rules
